lines: After working for the King for many years, researching spells that contribute to the kingdom's peace and prosperity, <color=#8836E0>Altheia the Witch</color> gained the overwhelming support of the citizens. The King grew wary, believing Altheia's influence a threat to his absolute authority. The King lured the unwitting witch into a trap and imrprisoned her in the deepest darkest dungeons, assigning the formidable Sphinx as her jailor. Altheia vowed to escape her imprisonment and get revenge on the proudful King.

Altheia rushes out of the dungeons, having narrowly avoided the Sphinx's watchful eye. She navigates through the labyrinth-like corridors of the castle expertly, reflecting on her time as an official magic researcher. She was so busy that she never had the chance to make any friends. Maybe she could have befriended Sphinx... but it is too late to have regrets now.

Lost in her thoughts, Altheia stumbles into the narrow passageway that leads to the throne room. However, a massive troll blocks her way! She has no choice but to confront the bulky creature in front of her.

Sneaking past the Troll, Altheia reaches the door to enter the throne room. She had once trusted the King and willingly served under him. After all, in world where witches are scorned, he had given her a place to live and a purpose. Yet, she was betrayed by her benefactor for a reason as petty as pride. Altheia enters the throne room and grimly faces the King, ready for battle. It's time to let him know what it's like to lose everthing.
